headline: Every tub of cheese checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With twice the milk going through Tullamarine, there are more tubs to get right every shift. Here's what a camera check could look like on your cheese line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its lid on, seated flat, with the seal intact underneath where it can be seen. A lifted lid on fresh cheese means leaks in the case and a complaint from the customer.
labelLede: Full cream and light ricotta tubs can look much the same at line speed, and the wrong one is a wrong claim on the pack. The camera checks every tub carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fresh cheese has a short use-by window, so the date has to be right and readable on every tub. The system reads the printed date and batch code and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Glove pieces, lid offcuts and loose machine parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a case.
